description: This file defines a final class 'ImmutableFeaturePropertiesBuilder' that implements 'FeaturePropertiesBuilder'. It provides a fluent API for constructing immutable 'FeatureProperties' objects backed by JSON data, with methods for setting, removing, building, and inspecting JSON fields. It appears to be part of a model for handling feature properties within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: ImmutableFeaturePropertiesBuilder
classes.description: A mutable builder class for creating 'ImmutableFeatureProperties' instances with a fluent API, managing internal JSON object construction.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Creates and returns a new empty 'FeaturePropertiesBuilder' instance.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates and returns a new 'FeaturePropertiesBuilder' initialized with data from a provided JSON object.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair in the JSON object for various data types, optionally filtered by a predicate.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a key or JSON field definition from the JSON object.

methods.name: setAll
methods.description: Sets multiple JSON fields from an iterable collection, with optional filtering.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns an 'ImmutableFeatureProperties' object based on the current state of the JSON builder.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the builder currently contains any fields.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of fields in the builder.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Provides a stream of JSON fields contained in the builder.
